items.title: Two Bats at a Cave Arch
items.alt: Two small bats hang at different heights inside a compact freestanding rocky cave arch, one awake and one sleeping.
items.description: Two small bats hang at different heights inside a compact freestanding rocky cave arch, one awake and one sleeping. Useful for compare-and-describe activities.

items.title: Bat with a Clinging Pup
items.alt: A gentle adult bat hangs from a sturdy twig with a tiny pup tucked against its chest, protective wings partly wrapped around both.
items.description: A gentle adult bat hangs from a sturdy twig with a tiny pup tucked against its chest, protective wings partly wrapped around both. Useful for family nature stories.

items.title: Three Bats Sharing a Branch
items.alt: Three distinct small bats hang along one short branch, facing forward, sideways and tucked asleep; different poses and ear angles.
items.description: Three distinct small bats hang along one short branch, facing forward, sideways and tucked asleep; different poses and ear angles. Useful for counting to three.
